headline: Reposted from @traploreross. Durks home wifi router COOKED him. Got multiple burner phones
body:
Reposted from @traploreross.

Durks home wifi router COOKED him. Got multiple burner phones but always connected back to his same home wifi router. Vonni used same wifi to book Uber to go get the murder car 🤦🏻‍♂️
